entities.name: N-acetyl-gamma-glutamyl-phosphate reductase
observations: Supplied 334-aa sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed UniProt Q0W932 from Methanocella arvoryzae.
Annotated as NADPH-dependent N-acetyl-5-glutamyl phosphate reductase, EC 1.2.1.38, in arginine biosynthesis.
Sequence-derived mass 36.7 kDa and theoretical pI 6.13; Pfam matches Semialdhyde_dh and C-terminal Semialdhyde_dhC domains.

entities.name: L-arginine biosynthesis
observations: The protein is annotated as catalyzing step 3 of 4 in the N-acetyl-L-ornithine route from L-glutamate.
